items.title: QI Brain — session + decision logging
items.detail: Register each Naya session in the Brain via qi.log_session() (prompt domains, file actions taken, models used) and log significant cleanup decisions via qi.log_decision(). Naya currently has no cross-project memory in the Brain.

items.title: Enable NEXUS routing by default for hard questions
items.detail: _try_nexus_synthesize() is built but gated off (personal.nexus_enabled=false). Decide a complexity threshold and turn it on so genuinely hard queries get multi-AI synthesis instead of a single local model.

items.title: QI Standards compliance pass
items.detail: Run qi_validator.py --project naya. Reconcile the legacy C:\UNIVERSAL\ECOSYSTEM references in CLAUDE.md with the migrated C:\QIH\ecosystem paths, and confirm the 7-folder QI layout (engine/config/data/logs/tests/docs/tools) — Naya is still flat at the repo root.

items.title: Wire Maia -> Naya file-intelligence API
items.detail: The registry advertises Naya exposing 'personal knowledge base queries' and 'file scout' to the ecosystem, but no stable contract is published. Define + document the endpoints Maia would call for space usage / recommendations.

items.title: Similarity-group housekeeping
items.detail: naya_brain.db has grown to ~2.3 GB with 2.7M naya_similarity_groups rows from accumulated scans. Add a retention/VACUUM policy and a 'reset dashboard' sweep for completed/cancelled scans (the reset_dashboard action exists) so the brain store stays lean.

items.title: Fuzzy-threshold tuning from real scans
items.detail: Review accumulated fuzzy_name groups to calibrate the near-duplicate matcher against real false-positive/negative rates rather than the current heuristic.

items.title: Reviewable cleanup workbook
items.detail: Before any bulk move/delete, emit a reviewable spreadsheet (xlsx) of candidate groups with a decision-override column, so the owner can edit decisions out-of-band and feed them back to the executor.

items.title: Surface FileHQ index richness
items.detail: folder_insight already reads the FileHQ index read-only; expand it to category/era breakdowns and scattered-duplicate warnings across folders (naya_memory relationship detection is stubbed).

items.title: Finish the LINE channel
items.detail: naya_line.py is present but no-ops without credentials. Decide whether the Naya OA is wanted at all (registry says Telegram is the only chat interface) — either wire creds + handlers or remove the module to reduce surface area.

items.title: Harden the peer bridge
items.detail: POST /webhook/peer-bridge carries HMAC-signed cross-bot messages. Add replay protection (timestamp/nonce), document the shared-chats contract, and add tests for the janitor that deletes sibling-bot status leaks.

items.title: Telegram webhook option
items.detail: A /webhook/telegram route exists alongside long-poll. If Naya ever moves off pure polling, finish + secure the webhook path — but only if the LAN-only / no-inbound-port constraint is relaxed (it should not be without reason).

items.title: Resume decision
items.detail: Naya is registry status 'paused' while its two services run. Make an explicit call: keep it as a maintained personal tool, fold its file-engine capabilities into another QI project, or formally retire it — so the running services aren't orphaned.

items.title: Flask -> FastAPI alignment
items.detail: naya_server.py is Flask while the rest of the ecosystem (Maia, NEXUS, FileHQ) is FastAPI. A migration would unify middleware, CORS-from-registry, and /version /info shapes — large effort, low urgency while paused.

items.title: Folder-strategy migration
items.detail: Per the QI folder strategy, personal projects may move under C:\APPS\QIP. Moving C:\APPS\NAYA would require repointing NSSM AppDirectories, naya_db paths, and the nightly sync — defer until the resume decision is made.

items.title: Service account review
items.detail: Decide whether QI_NayaBot / QI_NayaGradio should run under LOCAL SYSTEM or a dedicated account — it affects which drives the scanner can see and what the executor can delete.
